ucs.title: [LLM] Octo Tempest / Scattered Spider mass RMM agent install from user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider playbook of dropping one of a rotating cocktail of legitimate RMM tools (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Pulseway, Fleetdeck, Level, Atera, Action1, TacticalRMM, RustDesk, plus ngrok/fpipe tunnelers) from a help-desk-coerced user's Downloads/Temp folder, post initial-access social engineering. Catches the install BEFORE the operator pivots to AD/cloud creds.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","atera.exe","ateraagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","domotz.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","action1.exe","syncro.exe","ngrok.exe","fpipe.exe","chrome-remote-desktop-host.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search image=*\\Downloads\\* OR image=*\\Temp\\* OR image=*\\Public\\* OR image=*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* | join type=outer dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count as historic_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where earliest=-30d@d latest=-1d@d Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","atera.exe","rustdesk.exe","action1.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ngrok.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where isnull(historic_count) OR historic_count=0 | eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","atera.exe","ateraagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","domotz.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","action1.exe","syncro.exe","ngrok.exe","fpipe.exe","chrome-remote-desktop-host.exe"]);
let Lookback = 1d;
let HistoricalRmm = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
    | summarize by DeviceName, FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\")
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalRmm on DeviceName, FileName     // first-time-seen on this host
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","teamviewer.exe","splashtop.exe","sragent.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","atera.exe","ateraagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","domotz.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","action1.exe","syncro.exe","ngrok.exe","fpipe.exe"]);
let Lookback = 1d;
let HistoricalRmm = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ImageName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where tolower(ImageName) in (RmmBinaries)
    | summarize by Computer, ImageName;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ImageName in (RmmBinaries)
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalRmm on $left.Computer == $right.Computer, $left.ImageName == $right.ImageName
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|teamviewer|splashtop|sragent|pulseway|fleetdeck|level|atera|ateraagent|rustdesk|domotz|tacticalrmm|action1|syncro|ngrok|fpipe|chrome-remote-desktop-host)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Downloads|Temp|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk MFA reset → new-device cloud sign-in (0ktapus tradecraft)
ucs.description: Detects the signature Scattered Spider/0ktapus chain: admin/help-desk-driven MFA method change or password reset against a non-admin user, followed within hours by a successful interactive sign-in from a previously unseen IP — the exact pattern behind the MGM, Caesars, Twilio and Mailchimp intrusions where vishing the SD bypassed FIDO/TOTP.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as resetTime values(Authentication.src) as resetSrc values(Authentication.signature) as resetAction from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.signature IN ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password.","User registered security info","Admin registered security info for user","Update authentication phone","Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails","Disable Strong Authentication") by Authentication.user Authentication.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename user as target_user | join type=inner target_user [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as loginTime values(Authentication.src) as loginSrc values(Authentication.app) as app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.authentication_method!="Previously Satisfied" by Authentication.user Authentication.src_ip | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename user as target_user | join type=outer target_user src_ip [| tstats summariesonly=true count as historicSeen from datamodel=Authentication where earliest=-30d@d latest=-1d@d Authentication.action=success by Authentication.user Authentication.src_ip | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename user as target_user] | where isnull(historicSeen)] | where loginTime > resetTime AND loginTime < (resetTime + 14400) | eval delaySec = loginTime - resetTime, resetTime=strftime(resetTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), loginTime=strftime(loginTime,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table resetTime, loginTime, delaySec, target_user, resetAction, resetSrc, loginSrc, app | sort - loginTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let MfaResetActions = dynamic([
    "Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password.","Reset password (self-service).",
    "User registered security info","Admin registered security info for user",
    "User changed default security info","Update authentication phone",
    "Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails","Disable Strong Authentication",
    "Set force change user password"]);
let Resets = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
    | where ActionType in~ (MfaResetActions)
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn,
              ResetActor = AccountDisplayName, ResetAction = ActionType,
              ResetIp = IPAddress, ResetCountry = CountryCode;
let HistoricIPs = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | distinct AccountUpn, IPAddress;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend AccountUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner Resets on $left.AccountUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 4h)
| join kind=leftanti HistoricIPs on AccountUpn, IPAddress       // first-time IP for this principal
| project Timestamp, DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ResetTime),
          AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City, UserAgent, Application,
          ResetTime, ResetActor, ResetAction, ResetIp, ResetCountry,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 1d;
let MfaResetOps = dynamic([
    "Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","Update user",
    "User registered security info","Admin registered security info for user",
    "User changed default security info","Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails",
    "Disable Strong Authentication","Set force change user password",
    "User registered all required security info"]);
let Resets = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in~ (MfaResetOps)
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ResetActor, ResetAction = OperationName;
let HistoricIPs = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | distinct UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName), IPAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where ResultType == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner Resets on $left.Upn == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 4h)
| join kind=leftanti HistoricIPs on $left.Upn == $right.UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| project TimeGenerated, DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ResetTime),
          UserPrincipalName, IPAddress,
          Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
          City    = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
          UserAgent, AppDisplayName,
          ResetTime, ResetActor, ResetAction,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory (@evt.name:("Reset password (by admin)" OR "Reset user password" OR "Update user" OR "User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info for user" OR "Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails" OR "Disable Strong Authentication" OR "Set force change user password") OR (@evt.name:"Sign-in activity" AND @properties.riskLevelDuringSignIn:(medium OR high) AND @properties.isInteractive:true))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| (EventType=/passwordReset|securityInfoRegistered|strongAuthenticationUpdated|authenticationMethodChanged/i OR (EventType=/userLogin|signIn/i AND Result=success AND IsInteractive=true))
| join({
    #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
    | EventType=/passwordReset|securityInfoRegistered|strongAuthenticationUpdated|authenticationMethodChanged/i
    | rename(field=UserPrincipalName, as=ResetTarget)
    | rename(field=@timestamp, as=ResetTime)
  }, field=UserPrincipalName, key=ResetTarget, include=[ResetTime, ActorPrincipalName, EventType])
| @timestamp > ResetTime
| DelaySec := (@timestamp - ResetTime) / 1000
| DelaySec < 14400 AND DelaySec > 0
| groupBy([UserPrincipalName, RemoteAddressIP4, ActorPrincipalName], function=[min(DelaySec, as=DelaySec), min(@timestamp, as=LoginTime), collect([UserAgent, CountryName, EventType])])
| sort(LoginTime, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: This is the literal Scattered Spider / 0ktapus / UNC3944 kill chain Microsoft, Mandiant and CISA document repeatedly (MGM Sept 2023, Caesars, Twilio, Mailchimp, Riot Games): vish the SD into resetting MFA or pushing a temp password, then sign in from operator infra. The combination — admin-actor reset + sub-4h interactive login + first-time IP for that principal — is structurally rare for legitima
